Prayer :

Writ Petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of
 praying for issuance of Writ of Mandamus directing the respondents to de
 the compensation amount as per the judgement and decree dated 22.09.2017
 passed by the learned Subordinate Judge, Ponneri in L.A.O.P No.798 of
 1998 and as per representation dated 16.07.2025 and alternatively to dec
 the lands acquired by the respondents in G.O.Ms.No.749, Industries dated
 24.07.1990 published in Tamil Nadu Government Gazette part 2 section 2 d
 08.08.1990 stands lapsed.
For Petitioners: Mr. V.Chandrakanthan

For Respondents: Mr.P.Sathish, Addl. Govt. P
 Order
The petitioners' land was acquired under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 and compensation was determined under Award No.6/1993.
Pursuant to a reference, enhanced compensation was determined in LAOP.No.798/1998.

On __________ Page2 of 5 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis (
Uploaded on: 11/02/2026 01:27:18 pm ) the ground that such enhanced compensation has not been paid till date, the present writ petition has been filed.
2. Mr.P.Sathish, learned Additional Government Pleader, accepts notice for all the respondents.
He submits that the matter has been entrusted to an empowered committee and that a Government Order would be issued by the empowered committee within four weeks.

Pursuant thereto, he submits that the compensation amount would be deposited with the Principal District Court,
Tiruvallur within six weeks from today.

3. Recording the said submission, this writ petition is disposed of by directing that the compensation payable to the petitioners shall be deposited before the Principal District Court,
Tiruvallur within a maximum period of six weeks from today.
4.
The writ petition stands disposed of on the above terms without any order as to costs.
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition stands closed.
